added.summary: Reads the handle a field of entity i holds (a TableRow, an Entity, an asset) from the view, typed as the field's value: `og.table.get(world, a.handle(Foe, "row", i), Enemy)`. A handle column holds two u32 words a row, so `a.column(Foe).row[i]` was half of some row's handle and typed as a plain number; reading it took a world.get of the whole component per entity.
